title: Agentic In-Context Learning: What Algorithms Can Transformers Learn in Closed-Loop Interaction?
abstract: arXiv:2610.23051v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The learning algorithm view of in-context learning (ICL) studies how fixed-parameter Transformers learn from supplied examples. Language model agents extend this setting through interaction: their actions determine what evidence enters context next. We call this regime Agentic In-Context Learning (Agentic ICL). Existing studies largely depend on externally supplied contexts or reward-bearing interaction histories, while work on general tool-using agents lacks a learning algorithm view. We represent an interactive learner by its state, update, and decision rule, covering active learning, bandits, and online reinforcement learning (RL). For expressivity, we construct causal Transformers that approximate these algorithms over a finite horizon, and bound the resulting loss in return. translated_title: 智能体式上下文学习：Transformer在闭环交互中能学会哪些算法？
translated_abstract: 上下文学习（ICL）的学习算法视角研究的是固定参数的Transformer如何从所提供的示例中学习。语言模型智能体通过交互扩展了这一设定：它们的动作决定了接下来有哪些证据进入上下文。我们将这种机制称为智能体式上下文学习。现有研究主要依赖于外部提供的上下文或带有奖励信号的交互历史，而关于通用工具使用智能体的研究则缺乏学习算法的视角。我们用状态、更新和决策规则来表示一个交互式学习者，其涵盖主动学习、多臂老虎机和在线强化学习（RL）。在表达能力方面，我们构造了能够在有限时间范围内近似这些算法的因果Transformer，并对由此产生的回报损失给出上界。在训练方面，我们刻画了何时优化过程奖励能够保持最大化最终结果的行为。蒸馏实验表明，Transformer…
tldr: 本文提出“智能体式上下文学习”框架，首次从学习算法视角研究闭环交互中Transformer的可学习性，证明因果Transformer能够近似主动学习、多臂老虎机和在线强化学习等算法并给出回报损失上界，同时刻画了过程奖励优化在何时能保持最大化最终结果的行为。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Agentic In-Context Learning, offering the first learning-algorithm perspective on what Transformers can learn in closed-loop interaction, proving that causal Transformers can approximate active learning, bandit, and online RL algorithms with bounded return loss, and characterizing when process-reward optimization preserves outcome-maximizing behavior.
